mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the self-assignment fact lets Alloy invent a loan application where the assigned officer is the same User as the applicant; the injection forces that exact violating instance.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfAssignViolation { some a: LoanApplication | a.assignedOfficer = a.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the append-only fact lets two distinct AuditEntries record the same transition for the same application; the injection forces such a duplicate to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj e1, e2: AuditEntry | e1.app = e2.app and e1.prevStatus = e2.prevStatus and e1.newStatus = e2.newStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the access-policy fact allows the appResponse relation to map a non-owner caller to OkResponse, which is precisely an information-leakage counterexample; the injection forces such a leak to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakViolation { some u: User, a: LoanApplication | u != a.applicant and u != a.assignedOfficer and Auditor not in u.roles and (u -> a -> OkResponse) in AccessControl.appResponse }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the assigned-officer constraint lets an officer-attributed audit entry be authored by a User who is not the application's assigned officer; the injection forces such a misattribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnassignedOfficerViolation { some e: AuditEntry | e.actorRole = Officer and e.actor != e.app.assignedOfficer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the role multiplicity fact lets a User hold both the Officer and Auditor roles simultaneously, which the spec explicitly forbids; the injection forces that combination.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleConflictViolation { some u: User | Officer in u.roles and Auditor in u.roles }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the audit-attribution fact removes the no-auditor-writes constraint; the injection forces an audit entry whose actorRole is Auditor, which contradicts the read-only auditor invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditorWriteViolation { some e: AuditEntry | e.actorRole = Auditor }
